title: Mira's Hut
text: A small hut hung with drying herbs: lavender, sage, and roots in bundles from the rafters. Shelves of bottles line the walls, every one labelled. Mira moves among them without looking, the way you cross your own kitchen in the dark.

patches.title: Healing Herbs gone
patches.text: Remove the healing herbs from the picture.

patches.title: Mira gone
patches.text: Remove Mira from the picture.

patches.title: Lifelight Elixir taken
patches.text: Remove the lifelight elixir from the picture.

title: Tidal Causeway
text: Thin causeways of old stone run out across the black water. The wet stones shine under the moon. Broken arches stand along the way, and their shadows lie deep over a faded mural.

patches.title: Mira gone
patches.text: Remove Mira from the picture.

patches.title: Sea-Sealed Letter taken
patches.text: Remove the sea-sealed letter from the picture.

patches.title: Rusted Locker Key taken
patches.text: Remove the rusted locker key from the picture.

title: Shoreline Markers
text: Weathered steles stand in the cold sand, their faces full of shallow marks. Salt has smudged most of the lines, but moon sigils still show when the tide drops. Pale flakes sit loose in the grooves and catch the light.

patches.title: Polished Shell taken
patches.text: Remove the polished shell from the picture.

patches.title: Moon Rune Shards taken
patches.text: Remove the moon rune shards from the picture.

title: Outer Wards
text: The courtyard lies half under the sea. Three old pillars rise from the black water, their faces scored with shallow marks. Brine beads along the carved lines and catches the moon in small rings of light.

patches.title: Pillars purified
patches.text: Show the warding pillars cleansed, their glow clear and steady.

title: Collapsed Pier
text: The pier has fallen into the tide. Warped planks gape over dark vaults, and barnacled timbers stand up out of the water. The sea knocks against them, slow and steady.

patches.title: Weathered Coin taken
patches.text: Remove the weathered coin from the picture.

patches.title: Prism Lantern taken
patches.text: Remove the prism lantern from the picture.

title: Submerged Antechamber
text: A hall half under the tide. Salt-smoothed arches bear worn carvings that glow cold from within. It is very quiet. Somewhere further in, water drips.

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

patches.title: Lantern mounted
patches.text: Show a lit lantern mounted in the bracket on the wall.

title: Sanctum of the Tide
text: A vaulted chamber floored with still, dark water. Sigils show on its surface and shift as you look at them, and pale motes of light drift on the ripples. At the room's heart a shallow basin holds a cold brightness; the air tastes of brine and vows left unsaid.

patches.title: Way east closed
patches.text: Show the way east closed off.

patches.title: Crystal of Light taken
patches.text: Remove the crystal of light from the picture.

title: Lower Switchbacks
text: Paths wind back and forth across black, glassy rock, and ash blows on the wind. In the lee of the slope stands a scholar's camp: soot-patched canvas, low braziers, and racks where scorched notes and scraps of map flap. A workbench holds polishing stones and brass fittings for mending mirror segments, the kind found among the outcrops. Above the camp the slope climbs into obsidian, and vents hiss farther off.

patches.title: Emberwater Canteen taken
patches.text: Remove the emberwater canteen from the picture.

patches.title: Mira gone
patches.text: Remove Mira from the picture.

patches.title: Brass Mirror Segment taken
patches.text: Remove the brass mirror segment from the picture.

title: Obsidian Outcrops
text: Sharp towers of obsidian stand up out of the ash, their faces split into glassy facets. In the seams between them lie weathered mirror fragments and the marks of old mounts: brass filings and small bolt holes. Glass flakes slide away under every step.

patches.title: Brass Mirror Segment taken
patches.text: Remove the brass mirror segment from the picture.

patches.title: Binding Resin taken
patches.text: Remove the binding resin from the picture.

title: Mirror Terraces
text: Stepped platforms rise in rings up the slope, each ring set with sockets for mirrors and brass mounts. Channels cut in the stone carry light from ring to ring, toward the mountainside. Ash has settled on the worktables, over files and polish left where someone put them down.

patches.title: Brass Mirror Segment taken
patches.text: Remove the brass mirror segment from the picture.

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

title: Fumarole Passages
text: Narrow tunnels breathe heat in and out through vents in the stone, the way a sleeper breathes. Steam hangs in the low passages, and the air smells of sulfur and warm metal. Small holes and rubbed brass in the floor show where mounts were once bolted.

patches.title: Vent Stone taken
patches.text: Remove the vent stone from the picture.

patches.title: Way south open
patches.text: Show the way south open and passable.

title: Ember Gallery
text: A vaulted cavern veined with cooling lava; the air smells of charcoal and iron. Steam rises from cracks in the floor. On the worktables, fireglass and cooled slag lie sorted into heaps for wards, as if whoever sorted them meant to come back.

patches.title: Ash-Fern taken
patches.text: Remove the ash-fern from the picture.

patches.title: Cooled Slag taken
patches.text: Remove the cooled slag from the picture.

title: Phoenix Crater
text: A bowl of rock melted to glass, open to the sky. Warm drafts turn in it and carry cinders round in slow spirals. The air smells of hot iron.

title: Cavern Mouth
text: A broad arch opens into the hill, hung with cold mist. Lantern light dims a step inside it. Old signs are cut into the arch stone, worn too smooth to read.

patches.title: Mira gone
patches.text: Remove Mira from the picture.

title: Tool Cache
text: A side chamber shored with old timbers and stacked with crates of braces, iron fittings and coils of hemp rope. The walls are scored with tool marks, and the air smells of iron and wet earth.

patches.title: Reinforced Braces taken
patches.text: Remove the reinforced braces from the picture.

patches.title: Support Straps taken
patches.text: Remove the support straps from the picture.

patches.title: Wedge Blocks taken
patches.text: Remove the wedge blocks from the picture.

patches.title: Supply Crate appears
patches.text: Add the supply crate to the picture.

title: Collapsed Galleries
text: A gallery choked with fallen stone, floor to roof. The timbers that held it lie snapped under the pile, and dust hangs in the still air.

patches.title: Fallen Rock gone
patches.text: Remove the fallen rock from the picture.

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

title: Echo Chambers
text: Smooth caverns of bare stone. Every step comes back to you from the alcoves, and so does every word, a breath late, as if someone were copying you. Runes cover the walls, cut by three hands, the same words over and over.

patches.title: Old Oath Scrolls taken
patches.text: Remove the old oath scrolls from the picture.

patches.title: Resonant Chant Rubbings taken
patches.text: Remove the resonant chant rubbings from the picture.

title: Stillness Vestibule
text: A hush falls over this chamber like a shroud. Dark pools mirror the ceiling, so still they look frozen in time, and the stone seems to swallow every sound. At the centre, three weathered echo stones stand in a triangle. Their carved channels look made to catch whispered words and hold them.

patches.title: Stillwater Phial taken
patches.text: Remove the stillwater phial from the picture.

patches.title: Quiet Charm taken
patches.text: Remove the quiet charm from the picture.

patches.title: Wandering Phantoms gone
patches.text: Remove Wandering Phantoms from the picture.

patches.title: Way east open
patches.text: Show the way east open and passable.

title: Dragon's Hall
text: A hall of living stone opens beyond sight, its ceiling lost in shadow. Embers burn slowly along the floor, pulsing like a heartbeat, and somewhere in the dark, water drips. Rings of old sigils spiral across the black tiles around the Ancient Dragon. It lies coiled at the centre, scales like polished obsidian, and each slow breath hums in your bones.

patches.title: Dragon's Scale taken
patches.text: Remove the dragon's scale from the picture.

title: Entrance to Malakar's Fortress
text: A bastion of black stone rises from a shattered ridge. Iron lattices close its gates, and sigils glow behind them, slow as breathing. The wind up here is cold and smells of metal. Where the gate arch meets the wall an older carving shows through the black: a sun rising over three linked rings.

title: Ancient Dragon
text: A face portrait of an ancient dragon, its head heavy with dull worn scales, with golden eyes half open and unhurried.

title: Ash Scholar
text: A face portrait of a scholar with soot-streaked cheeks, singed eyebrows, tired intelligent eyes and wind-tousled hair.

title: Mine Overseer
text: A face portrait of a mine overseer with a face grey with rock dust, a heavy brow and uneasy eyes looking past you.

title: Miners
text: A face portrait of a grizzled old miner, his face grey with rock dust, with a deep frown and a lamp-lit stare.

title: Mira
text: A face portrait of a village healer in middle age, with a calm, steady gaze that rests on you a moment longer than is comfortable, and a sprig of dried sage tucked behind one ear.

title: Phoenix
text: A face portrait of a phoenix, its head feathers shading from gold to red, with a sharp beak and calm, unhurried amber eyes.

title: Phoenix Guardian
text: A face portrait of a masked guardian in a fire-etched mask and hood, only the eyes and lips showing.

title: Pier Warden
text: A face portrait of an old man with a salt-stiff collar, a seamed, sea-beaten face and pale eyes fixed on the water.

title: Silence Keeper
text: A face portrait of a figure in a deep hood, the face in shadow, with a pale chin and calm, still features.

title: Sir Cedric
text: A face portrait of a tall knight in his fifties with a weathered, tired face and a steady, watchful stare, a steel mail coif and a dented gorget around his neck.

title: Tide-Born Guardian
text: A face portrait of a guardian shaped of standing water, a face of clear liquid with ward-sigils drifting in it like weed.

title: Tobin
text: A face portrait of a boy of about fifteen, thin and pale, with his throat wrapped in a strip of torn shirt and his eyes turned upward and away.

title: Wandering Phantoms
text: A face portrait of a grey phantom, thin as breath on glass, a faint hollow face with open, whispering lips.

title: Elior
text: A face portrait of a farm boy of about nineteen, sun-browned and freckled, with untidy brown hair, an earnest, searching look, and the frayed collar of a homespun shirt.
